headline: Fronts Intensify Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition the bloodiest theatre, Weathered Expanse, has added another 22 ownership changes and its 24‑hour toll now stands at 176,564 Colonial and 194,163 Warden dead, with casualty streams and enlistments still accelerating. Fishermans Row has surged to sixteen flips — Black Well, Dankana Post, Arcadia, Eidolo and Fort Ember the busiest posts — pushing Colonial losses to 11,557 and Warden to 13,891. Stonecradle’s activity remains high at twelve flips centred on Buckler Sound, Colonial casualties at 59,690 and Warden at 75,439, both rates climbing sharply. Farranac Coast continues to churn with twelve flips, control split one Warden base to nine Colonial, and casualties at 47,144 Colonial and 58,227 Warden. Linn Mercy logs eleven flips around Lathair and Rotdust, totals 54,650 Colonial and 68,995 Warden, recruitment rising. Gutter, quiet in the prior report, now records eight flips centred on The Parras. Stlican Shelf adds five flips, while Mooring County sees only two. Deadlands, the northern Warden‑held sectors and several rear areas show no ownership changes in the last twelve hours.
